title: rosa canina subsp. hirtella
intro: Rosa canina subsp. hirtella, commonly known as the Prickly Rose or Dwarf Dog Rose, is a shrub-like plant that belongs to the Rosaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving heart health, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. Rosa canina subsp. hirtella is believed to have therapeutic actions including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties, which may help in soothing digestive issues and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Rosa canina subsp. hirtella include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
